en.title: Blades of Duality and the Echo of Falling Petals
en.premise: When magic-infused cherry blossoms scatter, the laws of the world are rewritten. I am a mercenary bearing the 'Twin Blades' forged to slay gods. Now, the other half of my soul—once severed from me—has reappeared as a calamity heralding the end of the world. Between what must be protected and what must be cut down, a rain of blood shall follow the silence.

zh.title: 双极之刃与落花之残响
zh.premise: 当蕴含魔力的樱花飘落之时，世界的法则将被改写。我是一名背负着旨在弑神的『双子之剑』的佣兵。而曾经分离的另一半，如今却作为宣告世界终结的灾厄，出现在我的面前。守护之物，与斩断之物。在静谧之后，血雨将至。
